info.title: MCP Tools REST API
info.description: Auto-generated REST API for MCP tools

post.description: Fetch public AppsFlyer product documentation from the AppsFlyer Knowledge Base (Zendesk) and Development Hub (DevHub). This is the authoritative source for AppsFlyer product knowledge: base every answer on the returned documents, never on training data. <content_scope> Zendesk is a customer suppo...

query.description: An optimized search query for the knowledge retriever. A well-structured query that includes relevant keywords, phrases, or questions will help optimize the retrieval process.

allow_hypothetical_chunks.description: Whether to allow hypothetical chunks in the response or only real pages.

score_threshold.description: Minimum score threshold for knowledge retrieval. 0 means default system threshold.

source_type.description: Type of source to filter knowledge (allowed: 'zendesk', 'devhub'). Empty means all sources.

top_k.description: Number of top entries to return. 0 means default system entries will be returned.

start_date.description: The start date of the date range, required, format: yyyy-MM-dd, default- last 7 days from yesterday

end_date.description: The end date of the date range, required, format: yyyy-MM-dd, default- yesterday

row_count.description: The number of rows to return, top x from the aggregated data

metrics.description: The metrics to get the data for.

attribution_source.description: The attribution source of the metric

aggregation_type.description: The aggregation type of the metric

app_ids.description: The app ids to get the data for

groupings.description: The dimensions to group the data by, use get_supported_metadata tool to get the supported dimensions,in case of a user asking for a dimension that is not supported, add the closest supported dimension

filters.description: The filters to apply to the data. key is a dimension, value is list of whitelisted values i.e 'Geo': ['US', 'CA'] or 'Media source': ['Facebook']

metric_name.description: The metric id to sort by

sort_by_metrics.description: The metrics to sort by. Each metric must be one of the fetched/requested metrics (i.e., included in the `metrics` parameter).

in_app_event.description: Specific event name representing user actions within your app

start_date.description: Start date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Skip the most recent 2 days of SKAN data.
start_date.title: Start Date

end_date.description: End date in YYYY-MM-DD format. Use inclusive ranges for date filtering.
end_date.title: End Date

kpis.description: List of KPI metrics to retrieve. Common mappings: ROAS→roas, ARPU→arpu, null conversion value rate→null_cv_rate
kpis.title: Kpis

sort_by.description: Sort criteria as [['field']] or [['field', 'asc|desc']]. Default direction is ascending.
sort_by.title: Sort By

groupings.description: Dimensions to group by. Use ['date'] for daily trends, ['date', 'media_source'] for breakdowns.
groupings.title: Groupings

totals.description: Include totals row in results. Use true for single metrics, false for detailed breakdowns.
totals.title: Totals

filters.description: Exact-match filters for dimensions. For media_source, use canonical names: 'googleadwords_int' for Google Ads, 'facebook' for Facebook.For example, to filter for Google Ads, use {'media_source': ['googleadwords_int']}.
filters.title: Filters

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Use for 'top N' queries.
limit.title: Limit

context.description: Query context for tracking and analytics. Not commonly used.

revenue_alt.description: Revenue in the customer pre-configured currency.
revenue_alt.title: Revenue Alt

exclusions.description: Exclude specific dimension values from results.
exclusions.title: Exclusions

inapps-kpis.description: In-app event KPIs to include in the query.
inapps-kpis.title: Inapps-Kpis

simulation.description: Enable simulation mode for testing queries. Don't pass unless requested.
simulation.title: Simulation

demo_mode.description: Demo mode type for sample data generation. Don't pass unless requested.
demo_mode.title: Demo Mode

Typical flow: list experiments to resolve the experiment_id you need, then call th...

app_id.description: Keep only experiments targeting this app (matches an experiment cell or a draft's app).
app_id.title: App Id

status.description: Filter by coarse list status. 'active' includes draft, scheduled, and running experiments; 'complete' means ended or stopped; 'all' (default) returns every experiment.
status.title: Status

media_source_pid.description: Keep experiments with a cell on this canonical media-source PID, e.g. 'facebook_int', 'googleadwords_int', or 'bytedanceglobal_int'.

media_source_name.title: Media Source Name

country.description: Keep experiments with a cell targeting this ISO country code (e.g. 'US').

run_id.description: UUID of the agent run to search (e.g. '3fa85f64-5717-4562-b3fc-2c963f66afa6')

question.description: Natural-language question about the agent run, e.g. 'Why did the campaign fail to install?'

post.description: Get aggregated creative performance data for the authenticated user. Returns CSV rows plus metadata JSON. Each row matches the group_by grain (omitted or [] = one overall totals row). Rows include creative_name and creative_id when grouped by creative. [creative IDs — operative only] creative_id,...

start_date.description: Start date (yyyy-MM-dd). Default: 7 days before yesterday. Must be a real calendar date; end_date - start_date must be ≤ 365 days.

end_date.description: End date (yyyy-MM-dd). Default: yesterday. Must be on or after start_date; span ≤ 365 days.

app_ids.description: App IDs to query within the authenticated account. Use [] for account-level scope — backend resolves apps configured in creative analytics (same scope as the dashboard). Pass explicit app_ids when the user names specific apps.

metrics.description: Regular metrics to fetch (0-15). May be empty when in_app_events + in_app_metrics are set. Do not put in-app aliases here — use in_app_metrics.

in_app_events.description: In-app event names to add as columns (up to 5 events, e.g. ["af_purchase", "af_login"]). Exact case-sensitive AppsFlyer event ids from the user. Must be paired with in_app_metrics. Unknown/wrong-case names typically return zeros.

in_app_metrics.description: In-app KPIs for each name in in_app_events: event_unique_users, event_count, event_revenue, event_cpa. Response columns are {event}.{metric} (e.g. af_purchase.event_count). Must be paired with in_app_events.

items.description: Public in-app event metric aliases (not part of SupportedMetric).

group_by.description: Dimensions that define each result row (0-4). Default when omitted: [] — one overall totals row. Pass [creative_id] to list/rank creatives. Add a dimension only if the user asks to segment/rank by it (by/per/broken down by); narrowing scope uses filters, not group_by. Do not add dimensions just to display columns. having applies at this grain.

filters.description: Restrict data without changing row grain. Use for media_source, channel, geo, campaign, platform, or specific creatives (e.g. country=US, media_source=unityads_int, creative_type=html, platform=ios, creative_id=<id>). Each filter has mode include (default) or exclude — exclude drops listed values. Do not include and exclude the same dimension in one query. media_source values are AppsFlyer PIDs (exact match), not brand names (e.g. applovin_int, googleadwords_int, facebook, unityads_int). creative_type values are lowercase IDs (html, video, image, carousel_image, text, link) — never HTML/Video/Image. platform values are lowercase OS ids (ios, android) — not iOS/Android display labels. video_len_in_sec is Duration in seconds (dashboard label). country values are ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes (US, DE, FR); United Kingdom is UK not GB. When group_by omits creative_id, filter by creative IDs here.

items.description: Single dimension filter. List form is required for OpenAI strict tool schemas.

mode.description: include (default): keep only these values. exclude: drop these values. Do not include and exclude the same dimension in one query.

having.description: Metric thresholds applied after aggregation (HAVING), before sort and row_count. Applies at the group_by grain — set grain to match the question first. Use for spend floors and KPI cutoffs (e.g. install_cost greaterThanEqual 500, roas_7 greaterThan 20). Values use the same numeric scale as returned CSV metrics. Do not invent post-filters — express thresholds here.

items.description: Metric threshold applied after aggregation (HAVING), before sort/limit.

metric.description: Metric to threshold (same allowlist as metrics).

operator.description: Comparison operator: greaterThan, greaterThanEqual, lessThan, lessThanEqual, equal.

value.description: Threshold value in the same numeric scale as returned CSV metrics.

metric.description: Metric to sort by (regular metric or {event}.{in_app_metric})

sort_by.description: Sort by metric and order. Regular metric id, or public IAE column {event}.{in_app_metric} when that pair is requested. Requires a non-empty group_by — rejected on overall totals (group_by []). When group_by is set and sort_by is omitted: defaults to first regular metric, else first IAE column, descending.

include_creative_urls.description: True when the user wants a URL to the actual creative (view, open, share, or link). False (default) when they only need names, rankings, or KPIs.

ALWAYS use this tool when the user gives you a OneLink URL or short link (for example "https://mysubdomain.onelink.me/abc123/my-promo") and wants to know what is behind it: which template owns it, the attribution/deep-linking par...

List Smart Banners for the account (metadata only; no creatives). Returns for each banner: id, name, banner group (name and id), website id, banner type (e.g. top/bottom), isActive, and lastModified. Does not include creative HTML or images. Soft-deleted banners are excluded, while inactive banne...

Get Smart Banner performance metrics for a date range. Returns impressions, clicks, dismiss, installs, re-attributions, retargeting, CTR, and CVR. The response includes the requested start/end window and granularity. Performance data is retained for at most 90 days. Do not request a start date ol...

banner_id.description: Banner UUID from list_smart_banners (or provided by the user).

start.description: Start date as YYYY-MM-DD (UTC); must be within the last 90 days.

granularity.description: "total" (default): single aggregate for the inclusive range. "daily": one entry per calendar day (zero-filled) plus the period total.

onelink_id.description: Required. OneLink template this custom link is based on (e.g. "G1bY"). Get it from get_onelink_templates. Never invent a placeholder.

shortlink_id.description: Required. Last part of the short URL (UI: Short URL). Customize it for the brand (e.g. email123). Cannot be changed after create. Letters, digits, '_' or '-' only, max 50.

domain.description: Required. Hostname for the short URL. If the account uses Branded Domains, pick one of the template's domains from get_onelink_templates.

pid.description: Required. Owned/custom media source (UI: Owned media source). Appears on the link as pid=. Use a custom name such as email, newsletter, brochures, web_cta. Integrated-partner names (facebook, googleadwords_int, …) are reserved and rejected. Cannot contain : < > * & ? = /.

link_name.description: Required. Custom link name for management only. Visible to the team; not added as a URL parameter and has no effect on link behavior.

campaign.description: Optional campaign name (UI: Campaign name). Appears on the link as the c parameter.

af_channel.description: Optional. Channel through which the ad is presented, e.g. "mobile_web" (UI: Channel).

af_adset.description: Optional. Ad set name. Ad sets contain one or more ads; often used for targeting, budget, schedule, bidding, and placement.

af_ad.description: Optional. Ad/creative name or identifier, e.g. "discount_blue_ad" (UI: Ad name).

af_sub1.description: Optional. Subscriber parameter 1. Record any useful KPI; parsed into raw data reports for aggregation or filtering.

af_sub2.description: Optional. Subscriber parameter 2. Same as af_sub1 — extra KPI dimension in raw data reports.

af_sub3.description: Optional. Subscriber parameter 3. Same as af_sub1 — extra KPI dimension in raw data reports.

af_sub4.description: Optional. Subscriber parameter 4. Same as af_sub1 — extra KPI dimension in raw data reports.

af_sub5.description: Optional. Subscriber parameter 5. Same as af_sub1 — extra KPI dimension in raw data reports.

is_retargeting.description: Optional. "true" if this link retargets existing users (UI: Retargeting campaign). Appends is_retargeting=true; metrics show on the Retargeting dashboard. Also turn on retargeting in App Settings.

af_inactivity_window.description: Optional. Inactivity window in days (e.g. 7). Users active during this window are ignored for retargeting. Appends af_inactivity_window.

af_reengagement_window.description: Optional. Re-engagement window (e.g. "30d" or "lifetime"): max time from click to re-engagement for attribution.

af_click_lookback.description: Optional. Click lookback window (e.g. "7d"). Maximum period from click to install/re-engagement when the user can be attributed to this ad (UI: Customize lookback window).

af_dp.description: Optional. URI scheme to launch the app (UI: Android and iOS fallback), e.g. "greatapp://". Overrides the template URI scheme. Do not use http/https if Android App Links are configured. On iOS, URI scheme often also needs af_force_deeplink=true.

af_web_dp.description: Optional. Web URL for desktop clicks (and social preview fallback). Overrides the template desktop redirect. Appears as af_web_dp.

af_ios_url.description: Optional. Web URL for iOS users when the app isn’t installed, overriding the template (App Store vs web URL). Appears as af_ios_url.

af_android_url.description: Optional. Web URL for Android users when the app isn’t installed, overriding the template (Google Play vs web URL). Appears as af_android_url.

af_r.description: Optional. Single-platform redirect URL when the app isn’t installed (af_r).

af_force_deeplink.description: Optional. "true" to force the URI-scheme deeplink. On iOS, most browsers will not trigger the URI scheme without this.

deep_link_value.description: Optional. Deep link value — in-app content for deep linking and deferred deep linking, e.g. "earbuds_gray_discount_page". Appears as deep_link_value. The template must have an app-open method, and the apps must implement deep-link handling.

deep_link_sub1.description: Optional. Additional deep link value, e.g. "extra_discount". Appears as deep_link_sub1.

af_cost_value.description: Optional. Fixed cost per install attributed to this link (UI: Enable cost per install). Pair with af_cost_currency.

af_cost_currency.description: Optional. Currency for that cost, e.g. "USD". Appended with af_cost_value.

af_prt.description: Optional. Agency/partner identifier on the link (af_prt).

af_xp.description: Optional. Link experience (UI: experience). Typical values: "custom" or "social". Social often pairs with a social app landing page.

af_qr.description: Optional. QR-code flag on the short URL (af_qr), e.g. "true", or "c" when a custom QR style is set.

af_og_title.description: Optional. Social media preview title (Open Graph). Up to 40 characters. Used when the link is shared on social.

af_og_description.description: Optional. Social media preview description (Open Graph). Up to 300 characters.

af_og_image.description: Optional. Social media preview image URL (Open Graph), e.g. https://image.example.com/photo-123. Recommended 1200x628 px, max 5 MB.

af_ios_store_cpp.description: Optional. App Store custom product page ID from App Store Connect (UUID). Do not set together with an iOS web URL override.

extra_params.description: Optional. Any other URL parameters not listed above, including custom keys and deep_link_sub2–10. Custom params can be read from conversion-data SDK APIs but do not appear in raw data reports. Cannot override pid or c.
